newcode='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != background]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in marked); r1 = max(r for r, c in marked)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in marked); c1 = max(c for r, c in marked)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        for r in (r0, r1):
            if grid[r][c] == background: out[r][c] = 2
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in (c0, c1):
            if grid[r][c] == background: out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
